[Issue #7302] Wire up attachment upload widget to opportunity edit form (#9730)

## Summary

Work for #7302

## Changes proposed

- **`OpportunityAttachmentUploadWidget`** — Fully implemented: i18n via
`useTranslations`, 2GB client-side file size validation, error `Alert`
on upload/delete failure, `isDraft` prop (disables input and hides
Remove buttons for non-draft opportunities), `deletable` flag
(initially-loaded attachments are display-only since the grantor GET
response does not return `opportunity_attachment_id`),
`crypto.randomUUID()` for stable unique keys on display-only files
- **`OpportunityEditForm`** — Added Attachments section wired to the
widget; section layout matches Figma (`display-flex flex-column gap-3`,
`padding-bottom-4`); accepts `initialAttachments` prop
- **`opportunityResponseTypes`** — `GrantorOpportunityDetail` now uses
`Omit<OpportunityDetail, "attachments">` to avoid type conflict between
`OpportunityDocument[]` (public endpoint) and `OpportunityAttachment[]`
(grantor endpoint)
- **`page.tsx`** — Passes `initialAttachments` to `OpportunityEditForm`;
passes `attachments: []` to `buildOpportunityEditInitialValues` (which
does not use attachments) to satisfy the `OpportunityDetail` type
- **`i18n/messages/en/index.ts`** — Added `content.attachmentsIntro` and
`attachments.*` error/action strings

## Context for reviewers

**Why `deletable: false` for initially-loaded attachments?** The grantor
GET endpoint (`/grantors/opportunities/{id}`) returns attachments via
`OpportunityAttachmentV1Schema` which does not serialize
`opportunity_attachment_id`. Without an ID we cannot call the delete
endpoint, so these files are shown as read-only. Only freshly uploaded
files (which get an ID back from the upload response) can be deleted.

**Why `Omit<OpportunityDetail, "attachments">`?** The public opportunity
detail uses `OpportunityDocument[]` (with `download_path`,
`file_description`) while the grantor endpoint uses
`OpportunityAttachment[]` (with `opportunity_attachment_id`,
`mime_type`, `file_size`). These are incompatible types so we omit and
re-declare rather than extend directly.

**Why `crypto.randomUUID()` for display-only files?** Initially-loaded
files have no `opportunity_attachment_id`, so we generate a stable UUID
at init time to ensure unique React list keys even when multiple files
share the same filename.

## Validation steps

1. Load the edit page for a draft opportunity with existing attachments
— files appear in the list (no Remove button)
2. Upload a new file — it appears in the list with a Remove button
3. Upload the same filename twice — no duplicate key console errors
4. Upload a file >2GB — error alert appears, file not added to list
5. Click Remove → confirm in modal → file removed from list
6. Click Remove → cancel → file remains
7. Load the edit page for a non-draft opportunity — file input is
disabled, no Remove buttons

Upgrade template-infra to v0.17.0 (remaining changes)

This PR completes the upgrade to template-infra v0.17.0, applying the
remaining changes that were not included in the S3 state locking migration PR #9672.

## Key Changes

### New Features
- Document Data Extraction module for structured data extraction
- SMS notifications support (similar to existing email support)
- Storage module configuration for service principal access
- Enhanced temporary environment documentation

### Infrastructure Improvements
- Updated GitHub Actions workflows with better error handling
- New workflow for scanning orphaned environments
- Enhanced build and publish workflows with release image support
- Additional documentation for custom domains, WAF, and monitoring

### Module Updates
- Database module restructured with resources subdirectory
- Network module reorganized with data and resources separation
- New notifications modules for phone pool and SMS
- Enhanced storage module with provider configuration

### Tooling & Scripts
- Updated scripts for better portability (#!/usr/bin/env)
- New stale-test-environments script
- Enhanced terraform init and apply workflows
- Improved orphaned environment detection

### Documentation
- New ADR documentation structure
- Enhanced infra docs for staging/prod environments
- Temporary environments and out-of-band resources guide
- Web application firewall documentation

Project-specific configurations preserved:
- Repository URL: HHS/simpler-grants-gov
- AWS Region: us-east-1
- Terraform version: 1.14.3
- Security group prefix configuration

[Issue #8988] Add subscribe / unsubscribe to user notification preferences page (#9691)

## Summary

Fixes / Work for #8988 

Adds notification preferences API integration and connects checkbox UI
to real data, including loading and error handling states with full test
coverage



## Context for reviewers

Implements backend integration for notification preferences so users can
view and update personal and organization-level email settings directly
from the UI.


## Validation steps

Navigate to Notifications page (eg `/notifications`)
- [x] [VERIFY] personal and org checkboxes reflect API state
- [x] [VERIFY] Toggle personal preference → confirm checkbox updates on
success
- [x] [VERIFY] Toggle organization preference → confirm correct org
updates
- [x] [VERIFY] Simulate failure → verify inline error + top error banner
appear
- [x] [VERIFY] loading state shows spinner while request is pending
- [x] [VERIFY] Confirm checkbox does not change on failed request

## Accessibility Validation Steps:

- [x] [VERIFY] Navigate via keyboard → checkbox is focusable and
togglable (Tab + Space)
- [x] [VERIFY] Focus state is clearly visible on the checkbox
- Screen reader announces:
- [x] [VERIFY] checked/unchecked state
- [x] [VERIFY] Toggle a preference → screen reader announces loading
state (via aria-live)
- On error:
- [x] [VERIFY] inline error is associated via `aria-describedby`
- to test this change `actions.tsx`, results to
```
     return {
      success: true,
      error: null,
    };
```
to

```
     return {
      success: false,
      error:"hello error",
    };
```

you, when you trigger the checkbox, it should read the error, and if you
remain on the checkbox, you should hear it describe the label + helper
text + error

- [x] [VERIFY] error message is announced to screen readers
- [x] [VERIFY] Top error banner is announced when it appears

[Issue #9667] Change button behavior on Edit Opportunity page (#9725)

## Summary

Work for #9667

## Changes proposed

- Renamed "Submit for review" button to "Publish"
- Disabled "Preview" button (feature not yet built)
- Enabled "Publish" button only when all 4 required fields are filled:
Publish Date, Funding Type, Funding Category, and at least one Eligible
Applicant
- Wired "Publish" button to backend `POST
/v1/grantors/opportunities/{id}/publish` endpoint — on success,
redirects user to `/opportunities`

## Context for reviewers

The Publish button lives in `OpportunityEditHeaderActions` (a `"use
client"` component) while the form state lives in `OpportunityEditForm`
(also a client component). Since they are siblings in the tree, a custom
DOM event on the shared form element is used to communicate field value
changes from the form to the header actions component.

The `publishOpportunityAction` server action calls the grantor publish
endpoint, which queues the opportunity for the publish workflow via SQS.
The workflow service then asynchronously sets `is_draft = false`. The
frontend redirects to `/opportunities` immediately after the API call
succeeds (the queue is accepted), not after the workflow completes.

## Validation steps

- [ ] Load the edit page for a draft opportunity with all 4 required
fields empty — Publish button is disabled
- [ ] Fill in Publish Date, Funding Type, Funding Category, and select
an Eligible Applicant — Publish button enables
- [ ] Clear Publish Date — Publish button disables. Re-fill — Publish
button re-enables
- [ ] Clear any one of the other 3 fields — Publish button disables
- [ ] Click Save — form saves correctly, no regression
- [ ] Click Publish (logged in as a user with `publish_opportunity`
privilege) — page redirects to `/opportunities`
- [ ] Preview button is always disabled

---------
